_comment: Single source of truth for every AI model artifact the app downloads. SHA-256 + size are byte-exact, verified at the time the lockfile was generated by curl + sha256sum against the official publisher. Do not edit URLs or SHAs casually — every entry is pinned to a specific upstream version. Re-run `./gradlew downloadAiAssets` to refresh after any intentional change.
_bundledField: Each entry MAY carry `"bundled": false`. When `false`, the Gradle download task (`downloadAiModelWeights`) skips that entry - the binary is NOT placed under `app/src/main/assets/ai-models/`, and is therefore NOT bundled into the APK. The runtime installer downloads the file from `url` on user demand and persists it under `filesDir/models/<dirName>/<fileName>`. Default is `true`. Download-only entries: whisper-large-v3 (PHASE B1.7, 2026-09-04).
_bundledOnlyField: 2026-09-06: the `bundledOnly` flag is no longer used by any entry. Every model in `models` is bundled-first (the Gradle download task ships the binary inside the APK under `app/src/main/assets/ai-models/` when the Gradle-level `bundled` field is true) AND downloadable in-app as a repair: the runtime installer copies the bundled asset offline on first use and falls back to the `url` when the asset is missing or fails SHA verification. Auto Frame (pose_landmarker_lite), Background Remove (selfie_multiclass), and AI Upscale (esrgan_tflite_4x) are bundled + repairable. Voice Clean (RNNoise) ships its weights inside the C source compiled into librnnoise.so and is therefore not represented in `models` at all - it has no in-app model of its own.
_sha256Source: Whisper Medium SHA was locally verified by a real download (2026-09-02) and re-verified by the 2026-09-04 B1.6 real-device inference test. The Whisper Large-v3 size (3095033483) and SHA-256 (64d182b440b98d5203c4f9bd541544d84c605196c4f7b845dfa11fb23594d1e2) were lifted from the official HuggingFace LFS `oid` field on the `ggerganov/whisper.cpp` mirror; LFS `oid` is the publisher-published content hash HuggingFace uses to address the file, so it is byte-identical to the actual file's SHA-256. PHASE B1.6 (2026-09-04) removed Tiny + Small from the production selection; their entries are gone from this lockfile and from the bundled assets. PHASE B1.7 (2026-09-04) added `bundled: false` to whisper-large-v3 so the 3.1 GB binary is downloaded by the user, never bundled. PHASE B2 (2026-09-05) flipped `esrgan_tflite_4x` from download-only to bundled-only - the 5 MB binary is now packaged inside the APK and the AI Upscale panel no longer offers a download button. Auto Frame and Background Remove were already bundled.

nativeLibs._comment: whisper.cpp source tarball. Extracted into app/src/main/cpp/whisper/ + app/src/main/cpp/ggml/ by the Gradle download task. Compiled into jniLibs/<abi>/libwhisper.so + libggml.so by the existing externalNativeBuild + CMakeLists.txt. v1.7.6 already includes the WHISPER_AHEADS_LARGE_V3 ahead-array so Large-v3 is supported at the JNI level.

rnnoise._comment: RNNoise (Xiph, BSD-3-Clause) classic small-model source snapshot, vendored via the Yellow-Dog-Man/rnnoise fork which adds a plain CMake + jni/Android.mk build on top of the unmodified upstream DSP/neural sources. The fork carries the pre-trained 8-bit quantized GRU weights in src/rnn_data.c (~87 KB model) so no separate weight download is needed at runtime: the weights compile into librnnoise.so and Voice Clean runs fully offline. Upstream provenance: https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise (paper arXiv:1709.08243). Tarball pinned to commit f0b73e38c029660bc6e010b583b406f6470f8a1b; SHA-256 + size verified 2026-09-04 by real download via codeload. Extracted by the Gradle download task into app/src/main/cpp/rnnoise/ and built by app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt into librnnoise.so (+ JNI bridge in rnnoise-jni.cpp). License files (COPYING/AUTHORS) are preserved under app/src/main/cpp/rnnoise/.

models._comment: 2026-09-08 SPEED RESTORE (v2) — Whisper Small f16, download-only (bundled: false). The first restore attempt shipped the q5_1 quantized build (190 MB); real-device Persian tests showed q5_1 produces per-character BPE tokens (letter-by-letter subtitles with missing pieces) — quantization degrades the Persian token distribution. The f16 build is the byte-exact upstream file the B1.6 audit originally tested: full Persian words, ~3x faster than Medium. Size + SHA-256 lifted from the official HuggingFace LFS oid on the ggerganov/whisper.cpp mirror.

models._comment: MediaPipe Selfie Multiclass 256x256 - powers Background Remove. 2026-09-06: bundled (16 MB) with in-app download repair - the installer copies the bundled asset offline on first use and falls back to this url when the asset is missing/corrupt. 2026-10-15: the entry had drifted to bundled:false, which made Background Remove depend on a single storage.googleapis.com URL; a device report showed that host answering HTTP 403 on the target network, so the model ships inside the APK again. The bundled binary is byte-verified: 16371837 bytes, sha256 c6748b1253a99067ef71f7e26ca71096cd449baefa8f101900ea23016507e0e0. NOTE: the same lockfile is kept in app/src/main/assets/ai-models/ — BundledAssetIntegrityTest asserts the two stay semantically identical.

MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite - powers Auto Frame. 2026-09-06: bundled (5.6 MB) with in-app download repair - the installer copies the bundled asset offline on first use and falls back to this url when the asset is missing/corrupt.

ESRGAN TFLite 4x (official TensorFlow Android super-resolution demo model, TFHub captain-pool/esrgan-tf2 converted with dynamic-range quantization). 2026-09-06: bundled (5 MB) with in-app download repair - the runtime installer copies the bundled asset app/src/main/assets/ai-models/esrgan_tflite/ESRGAN.tflite on first use, SHA-verifies, and the engine loads the file; when the bundled asset is missing/corrupt the AI Upscale panel's download button fetches this url in-app. Size 4993712 + SHA-256 verified by real download from the stable download.tensorflow.org URL (unchanged since 2020-10-27). Fully-convolutional generator: inference runs tiled (default 64x64 tiles, 8px overlap-blend) so arbitrary frame sizes work frame-by-frame without loading the video into RAM. Runtime: TFLite Java Interpreter (CPU 4 threads, GPU delegate when available). 2x profile = ESRGAN 4x on a 0.5x-prefiltered frame (net exactly 2x); 4x profile = direct ESRGAN 4x.

models._comment: MediaPipe BlazeFace Short-Range - powers the Face Detection fallback of Auto Frame. 2026-09-06: close-up shots where the body is out of frame defeat the Pose Landmarker; this 230 KB detector keeps subject tracking alive by locking onto the face. Bundled (230 KB) with in-app download repair - the runtime installer copies the bundled asset app/src/main/assets/ai-models/face_detector/blaze_face_short_range.tflite on first use and falls back to this url when missing/corrupt. Size 229746 verified by real HEAD download from the official MediaPipe bucket.

Tesseract tessdata_fast Persian (fas) — powers AI OCR. 2026-09-10: downloaded from the official tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast GitHub repo, SHA-256 verified by real download. Integrate mode: fas is the primary model; eng/ara are loaded alongside as secondary scripts (Persian text routinely contains Latin fragments). tessdata_fast is the speed-optimized integer build of the LSTM models — real on-device inference on all ABIs the app targets.
